question: Which countries in europe have at least 4 car manufacturers?
gold_query: SELECT T1.CountryName FROM COUNTRIES AS T1 JOIN CONTINENTS AS T2 ON T1.Continent = T2.ContId JOIN CAR_MAKERS AS T3 ON T1.CountryId = T3.Country WHERE T2.Continent = 'europe' GROUP BY T1.CountryName HAVING count(*) >= 4
